pairs.difference: A: the bale holds one light-to-middle mass on two flat background bands, with one dark cast shadow under its right side. B: light and dark streaks in the wood fill the card, clipping to white at top right, and they compete with the mid-grey book. A hard black shadow runs along the book's lower edge. All numbers are in range, so this rests on grouping only.
pairs.fix: Keep the wooden table as one calm mid-tone with faint grain, no bright streaks. Use a single soft shadow beside the book.

pairs.difference: A: clean groups, with white awning stripes and pale paving against a dark cart body, and dark accents kept to the wheels and scallop shadows. B: the barrel staves break into speckled grey, the dirt is a noisy light-mid scatter, and black patches sit low on the barrel and its lower band. rms 0.123 is near the bottom of the real range. Weak evidence.
pairs.fix: Paint the barrel staves as smooth, broad light and shadow shapes with no speckle. Keep the ground one quiet tone and put the darkest shadow only where the barrel meets the ground.

pairs.difference: A: the dark machine body is relieved by a bright window frame, on a middle background with a soft pale pool low down. B: a near-black lantern frame cuts hard against a pale clear glass and a light background, with black also on the table's bottom edge. rms 0.189 is above the real maximum and gap -0.243 just below the real minimum.
pairs.fix: Make the lantern metal a dark grey with soft highlights instead of glossy black. Lower the brightness of the wall behind it and soften the jump between frame and background.

pairs.difference: A: flat middle background with a thin bright neon outline and a mid-value cone and swirl. Value relief is moderate, though a pale halo sits around the outline. B: the sky and city clip to a near-white mass with the top sliver the only tone, against a hard dark-and-white metal hero. rms 0.170 and gap -0.246 both reach beyond the real limit on the high-contrast side.
pairs.fix: Give the sky and city a soft mid-light blue with visible tone instead of washed-out white. Shade the metal viewer with gentle steps, not black bands beside white streaks.

pairs.difference: A: the dark coach is surrounded by scattered small lights, with pale streaks across the ground and broken white clouds, and dark accents spread through the wheels and undercarriage. B: larger groups, with pale seats, a broad bright sky opening inside the loop and dark top corners. Both have a gap just below the real range and B's vignette of 0.117 is high, so this is a thin call.
pairs.fix: Paint the dirt ground as one even warm tone without pale streaks. Make the clouds fewer and larger, and keep the darkest shadow under the coach only.

pairs.difference: A: a flat dark striped backdrop gives a strong value drop against a light hat with a hard pale rim, and lightness 0.565 is slightly under the real floor. B: a pale ring glows behind the sandals and clips the stripes, the sole sits in the same grey group as the background so it separates by hue only, and lightness 0.795 is slightly over the real ceiling. Both are borderline.
pairs.fix: Remove the bright glow behind the sandals. Make the backdrop a steady, slightly darker teal so the coral soles stand out by lightness as well as color.

pairs.difference: A: stage card with light beams, dark truss corners and a pale pickguard inside a dark guitar. It is busy, and vignette -0.10 is under the real minimum. B: dark-mid horse with black mane, tail and legs against pale clouds, and a bright oval pool on the floor beneath it. Gap -0.287 is well below the real minimum, so the hero is darker than any real card's.
pairs.fix: Lighten the horse to a warm mid tone and make the mane and tail dark brown, not black. Keep the floor even, with no bright pool under the hooves.

pairs.difference: A: pale all-over key, with the background and sand in one light group, a soft mid cactus and only a mild shadow on the left. Lightness 0.756 is above the real range and rms 0.092 is well under its floor. B: a wider spread, with white deck, mid wave backdrop and dark under-slide shadows, and rms sits exactly at the real minimum.
pairs.fix: Deepen the orange backdrop and sand by a step. Give the cactus a darker shaded side and a firm dark contact shadow at its base.

pairs.difference: A: a near-white glass stands on a dark backdrop with a lighter diamond glow around the hero. Gap 0.257 exceeds the real maximum and vignette -0.025 is under the real minimum. B: a mid-dark jug on a middle background, one dark contact shadow low right and a single highlight, which matches the real large-group structure. Its rms of 0.107 is slightly low.
pairs.fix: Tone the glass and drink down so the ice and rim are the only near-white spots. Remove the bright glow behind the glass.

pairs.difference: A: one large dark-mid pillow on a light field, with a white hole and small black accents in the inner folds, which reads as a clear two-mass design. B: a dark door fills the card with leaf speckle around the top and sides, no large light group, and only a small white wall patch at right. Lightness 0.552 and vignette -0.07 are both outside the real range.
pairs.fix: Open up the card with a lighter wall or sky around the door. Group the leaves into a few calm mid-tone clusters and make the door a lighter, even blue.

pairs.difference: A: dark red bandana on a single light background, with a small black accent in the fold and white motifs, giving clear value separation. B: mid-value towel on a mid-value green, with gap 0.038 so separation is by hue. The grey-level lens shows dense speckle across the stripes, and rms 0.076 is under the real floor.
pairs.fix: Darken the green background a step and clear its glow behind the towel. Paint the towel with smooth broad folds and one clear shaded side instead of grainy texture.

pairs.difference: Both share a sunburst with a bright centre. A: hero and background sit at the same lightness (gap 0.002), a white-hot bloom fills the chimney, and vignette 0.144 goes above the real maximum with dark top corners. B: the pan is darker than the field and has a firm dark underside crescent. Its vignette of 0.123 sits at the real edge. Slim difference.
pairs.fix: Drop the dark corners so the background stays even. Reduce the white flame glow to a small warm spot and let the brass base carry a darker shaded side.

pattern: Generated cards push the value range to extremes in one of two ways. Either the hero sits against a lit halo or clipped pale backdrop, or the hero is too dark and too light in hard adjacent bands. Value groups break up into speckle and streaks on floors, foliage and textiles, where real cards keep large calm masses with the darkest accent placed once at the contact shadow.
